commands.name: assign-ticket
commands.description: Assign a ticket to appropriate agent using orchestration protocols

commands.name: create-ticket
commands.description: Create a new ticket in the issues tracking system
examples: /create-ticket Fix Google Sign-in User ID Extraction type=Bug severity=Major effort=M
/create-ticket Fix login bug type=Bug severity=Blocker effort=M project=my-app auto-assign=true

commands.name: handoff-report
commands.description: Create a detailed report of the work done and work that needs to be done for incomplete tickets

commands.name: lazy-request
commands.description: Transform my request into a structured brief, then execute it.
examples: /lazy-request Analyze the database schema and suggest optimizations
/lazy-request Create a marketing strategy for mobile app launch

commands.name: optimize-agent
commands.description: Select and optimize an agent using the agent-optimizer specialist

commands.name: design-loop
commands.description: Produce a design with a chosen agent, auto-QA it, and iterate once if it fails QA
examples: /design-loop senior-frontend-layout-expert "Create a login screen" brand=<AppName> platform=mobile

commands.name: create-campaign
commands.description: Generate a zero-budget guerrilla marketing campaign for a product
examples: /create-campaign MyApp productivity https://example.com "indie hackers" reddit 7days educational
/create-campaign MyApp fitness-app https://example.com "gym beginners" discord 14days meme-heavy

commands.name: update-engineering-agents
commands.description: Systematically update all engineering agents with core standards and compliance

commands.name: start-ticket
commands.description: Start work on a ticket by routing it through the agent orchestration system

commands.name: venture-pack
commands.description: Execute comprehensive multi-agent business strategy analysis workflow
